title: Conspiracy
grade_or_penalty: Same degree as the most serious target crime; conspiracy to commit a 1st-degree crime is 2nd degree, except murder and certain drug/terror crimes (2C:5-4)
key_points: Agreeing with another to commit a crime, or to aid in its planning or commission.
An overt act is required unless the target is a 1st or 2nd degree crime.
